entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi David. I'm calling about an order I received last week. I need to return a pair of cycling shoes.
I can certainly look into that for you. To understand the situation better, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the shoes? Is it a technical fault or a matter of preference?
It's a fit issue. They felt okay when I tried them on, but after my first ride with them, they've given me terrible blisters right on my heel.

I'm very sorry to hear that. Getting blisters is definitely not the experience we want for our customers. Comfort is crucial. Let me just confirm your order details. I see you received the shoes 6 days ago.
Yes, that's right. It was a 20-mile ride, nothing crazy. I think the stiffness around where the cleats mount is just not right for my foot.
I understand completely. Not a problem at all. You are well within our 90-day return window, so I can go ahead and process a full refund for you right away.

Okay, that's great news. I appreciate you making that easy. Since I'll have to go through the hassle of packaging these up and buying a different pair, would it be possible to get a small discount code for my next VeloFit purchase?
I certainly understand why you're asking. While our policy allows for the full refund on the cycling shoes, I'm not authorized to provide a discount code for a standard return like this.
I see. Not even a 10% off code? I plan on buying another, more expensive pair from your site, so it would help offset the inconvenience.

I do apologize, but my system is firm on that. However, I can assure you that the refund process will be quick and painless. I've just emailed you a prepaid return label. As soon as we receive the item back at our warehouse, the refund will be issued to your original payment method.
Alright, I suppose a prompt refund is the most important thing. I've received the email. Thanks for your help, David.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I hope we can find you a pair of shoes that are a perfect fit next time. Have a great day.
